title: MSA One 54 available
message: MSA One 54 fixes Android header overlap, reorganizes Storage, and adds swipe-down dismissal for Office More Options.
releaseNotes: Android status-bar safe-area bridge prevents workspace/header overlap
Office More Options can be dragged or swiped down to dismiss
More Options height reduced to keep more document visible
Files Storage reorganized into Device and Folder Access groups
Storage rows now use consistent dark MSA One styling
